description: SKUEL dependency upgrade policy — see app/docs/decisions/ADR-067-dependency-upgrade-policy.md. PR-only, no auto-merge; verify every bump locally (./dev quality + ./dev test-integration) before merge. CI runs unit + integration tests (testcontainer Neo4j) on py/cypher changes as a backstop.

docker-compose.description: Enabled for the Neo4j sandbox compose: the server image tracks the latest published calendar monthly (ADR-067 § 3a) — Renovate proposes each bump as a PR, CI's testcontainers run the proposed image (tests/integration/_neo4j_pin.py reads this same pin) and the version canary proves they agree. Scope is narrowed by the package rule below, NOT here: managerFilePatterns is additive to the manager defaults and cannot exclude files.

packageRules.description: Group routine minor/patch bumps into one reviewable PR.
Major bumps get their own PR — they may need an ADR / migration.

INTENTIONAL PINS (ADR-067 § Pins) — the neo4j DRIVER stays on the last 5.x, decoupled from the server (ADR-067 § 3); deepgram 5.x+ is a breaking rewrite. Bump only via a deliberate migration, never a routine PR. pypi-scoped on purpose: the `neo4j` DOCKER image is the server and MUST flow (next rule).
The app compose files' images (MariaDB, Firefly, Prometheus, Grafana, Caddy) are dev-only sidecars that stay manual — the docker-compose manager is on for infrastructure/docker-compose.yml alone.

Neo4j SERVER image — the calendar-monthly treadmill (ADR-067 § 3a). Merging moves the stopped local sandbox's store forward on its next start (downgrades unsupported); AuraDB, the daily graph, is unaffected.
prBodyNotes: ⚠ ADR-067 § 3a: merging migrates the local sandbox store forward on its next `./dev up-neo4j` — no downgrade path. CI's integration job runs the proposed image; `test_apoc_canary` must be green before merge.

packageRules.description: Group routine JS minor/patch bumps into one reviewable PR, mirroring pep621.
Major JS bumps get their own PR — same reasoning as pep621 majors.
